[[File:Rokna_tree_fungus.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A rokna tree with [[Rokna tree fungus|rokna fungus]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].]]
The '''rokna tree''' was a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The plant was featured on [[Vanvi Hotne]]'s painting ''[[Ronka Plant]]''.<ref name="SWG:P6">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Publish 6: "The Imperial Crackdown"</ref> The [[Rokna tree fungus]], a very toxic fungus for [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], was known to grow on rokna trees.<ref name="TSD">{{Ewoks|To Save Deej}}.</ref>
